description: A script that reads Chromium locale resource files for different platforms, parses XML data to extract font family settings, and outputs a JSON structure mapping scripts and font families.

classes.name: ScriptFontFamilies
classes.description: A class managing a mapping from script names to font family configurations, with methods to set fonts and serialize to JSON.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets a font family value for a given script and family name.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the font families mapping into a JSON-compatible object.
